name: Nightmare Forest ~Injuu no Seiran~
original_name: ナイトメア・フォレスト ～淫獣の聖卵～
source:
* Deep in the forest unfolds the feast of demons and goblins! From giant hills to Orochi, an eight-headed serpent, and even more mysterious and vile creatures attack our heroine!

Anne and Io, full of the eggs of vile beasts, are invited to the feast of voluptuous tentacles...

Girls impregnated with eggs. A mysterious boy. And a beast called "Nightmare".

The lewd and tragic incident that occurred deep in the forest would lead Anne and Io to a surprising conclusion...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039921.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
* 森林深處，惡魔與妖精的盛宴上演！從巨大的山丘到八個頭的八岐大蛇，還有更多神秘而邪惡的生物攻擊我們的女主角！

體內被塞滿淫獸卵的安妮和艾歐，受邀赴一場淫靡的觸手盛宴……

體內孕育著獸卵的女孩。一個神秘的男孩。還有一種叫做「夢魘」的野獸。

發生在森林深處的淫蕩悲慘事件，將讓安妮和艾歐得出一個驚人的結論……

[出自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039921.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
